name: handoff
description: 작업 종료 시 다음 작업자 핸드오프 자동화 — docs 체계적 기록·회귀 가드·harness 점검·HANDOFF 문서 생성

interface.shortDescription: Work-closeout automation for the next worker.
interface.longDescription: One trigger runs the whole closeout: capture git and build state, guard against regressions and untracked deploy files, lint and repair the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md harness, write structured records under docs/ (sessions, decisions, regressions), and produce a single docs/handoff/HANDOFF.md entry point the next person or agent reads first. Respects existing project conventions instead of imposing a new layout.
defaultPrompt: Use $handoff to wrap up this session and write a handoff for the next worker.
Use $handoff to capture what changed, record open issues, and refresh HANDOFF.md.
Use $handoff to check for regressions and untracked files before I stop working.
